title: Patch: Units underneath a Stack should be summoning sick when they resummon

**Issue #1829 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #1829: Patch: Units underneath a Stack should be summoning sick when they resummon
Opened by @MaxGoetzmann.

### What it does

Right now. For instance, playing a Juhan's Biggest Bat on turn 2 Stacked on top of a Felinor token played turn 1 leaves a Juhan's Biggest Bat underneath it that can attack right away if the original one dies. That's a lot of unexpected damage.

### Acceptance

Units under a Stack, when the card above them dies, should reappear as summoning sick. This, of course, only matters if they reappear on your turn.
```
